$NVDAB slipped 1.87% to 203.57 USDT, trading between 209.25 and 201.26 USDT with about 10.76 M USDT of volume.

Cerebras' $CBRSB nudged up 1.133% to 108.94 USDT, a tight range of 109.41-104.4 USDT and 351 K USDT moving hands.

Tesla's $TSLAB held near 400 USDT, up 0.962% to 399.96 USDT, high of 404.59, low of 388.14 and 4.05 M USDT traded.

All three keep grinding 24/7, no big spikes, just steady crypto-hour action.

$BTC slipped 0.19% to $77,319, hugging the day-low of $76,325 and staying under the $78,800 peak. Volume held near 17.4k BTC, so the move wasn't a flash crash.

$ETH nudged up 1.2% to $2,242, carving a small gain from the $2,208 floor and still below the $2,262 high. Heavy flow, about 338k ETH, kept the price breathing.

$BNB dropped 0.62% to $705.6 after testing $722 before sliding back to $694. Around 236k BNB changed hands, pushing the quote volume past $166 M.

Watch the $BTC order book around the $77,000-$78,000 band; any fresh swing past $78k could reshape the short-term range.

$BTC slid to $76,922, down 3.26% on the day. It bounced off a high of $79,687.92 but couldn't stay above the $76,326 low, leaving volume around 28,672 BTC.

$ETH hovered at $2,245.6, a 1.91% drop. The pair peaked at $2,294.48 and found support near $2,174, with roughly 554,692 ETH changing hands.

$BNB ended at $700.58, off 1.56%. It flirted with $722.08 before slipping back to $682.16, trading about 435,135 BNB.

Watch the $BTC 78k-80k zone; if price tests that ceiling again it could set the tone for the next swing.

$BTC slipped to $77,233, down 4.8% on the day. The high hit $81,152 before the price fell back toward the $76,500 low. Volume was about 33.5 k BTC, moving roughly $2.62 bn in quote.

$ETH dropped 4.7% to $2,240.83, after peaking at $2,351.76 and testing $2,174.08 on the downside. Trade activity hit 656 k ETH, swapping close to $1.48 bn.

$BNB took the biggest hit, down 6.25% to $701.38. It bounced from a $748.22 high but couldn't stay above $680. Volume topped 618 k BNB, worth about $436 m.

Watch the $BTC price action around the $77k-$78k zone; a break either way could set the next short-term range.

$PEPE's up 7.76% to $0.00000528, spiking near its $0.00000568 high while volume surged past $293 M. $HYPE followed with a 4.36% gain, trading at $92.26 after bouncing off a $97.74 peak. Meanwhile $INTC plunged 25.55% to $68.84, sliding from a $93.54 high and dumping $50 M in volume. The leaders are ripping ahead; the laggard is tumbling hard. Just a wild swing in the last day.

$HYPEUSDT jumped 16.5% to $91.22, flashing a high of $97.74 before slipping to $78.19 on the way up. $TRXUSDT added 6.4% to settle at $0.352, nudging a $0.3654 peak while staying above $0.3286. Meanwhile $NEARUSDT fell 7.1% to $4.098, trading between $4.69 and $3.909. Volume stayed hefty across the board, with $HYPEUSDT moving over 186 M USDT and $NEARUSDT pushing 228 M. One pair's sprint, another's stumble, that's the 24-hour spread.

$BTC slipped to $79,472, down 2.1% in 24 h, after hitting $81,971 and testing $78,297 low. Volume sat around 20,100 BTC, $1.61 B in quote.

$ETH slid to $2,286, a 3.07% drop, with a high of $2,379.55 and a low near $2,233. Roughly 336,700 ETH traded, $778 M total.

$BNB fell hard to $708.84, off 6.25% after a swing from $761 high to $680 low. It moved about 497,100 BNB, $364 M quote.

All three sat lower, BTC and ETH modestly bruised, BNB taking the biggest hit. Keep an eye on whether the lows hold or if any token can claw back toward its recent highs. No fireworks, just a steady pullback across the board.

$BNB's been a bit looser than usual, its 24-hour swing sat at about 3.05 % versus the typical 2.63 %, roughly a third wider.

$BTC showed a similar pattern, moving around 2.80 % today while it normally hops about 2.27 %, so it's about 23 % broader.

$ETH was the widest of the three, clocking a 4.21 % range against its usual 3.30 %, that's almost a 27 % bump.

All three sat a touch above their normal volatility bands, nothing wild but definitely more room than we normally see.

$ETH is nudging up against $BTC, +0.069% in the 24-hr ETH/BTC pair. Meanwhile $BTC slipped 0.832% today, but the average of the top 20 altcoins fell a touch harder at –0.866%. So Bitcoin's losing a bit less than the basket. ETH's tiny gain shows a bit of relative strength, but overall the market's just edging lower. Nothing wild, just a modest pullback with $BTC holding a slight edge over the alts.

$BTC slipped to $79,848, down 1.46% on the day, pulled back from a high of $81,823 and barely nudged above $79,710. $ETH fell 2.37% to $2,305, after topping out at $2,391.55 and hovering near $2,293.44. $BNB was almost flat, down 0.03% at $746.32, stuck between $744.30 and $762.20. Volume stayed solid across the board, $BTC traded about 13.6k, $ETH 202k and $BNB 148k units.

Watch the $BTC 24-hour low-high spread; a tighter range could set the next swing's boundary.

$NVDAB slipped 1.86% to 213.72 USDT, hugging its low of 212.9 after peaking at 220.45. Volume held at about 11.6 M USDT, so the move kept rolling through the night.

Tesla's tokenized stock, $TSLAB, dropped 1.4% to 401.65 USDT, nudging just above its 397.8 USDT low. Still, it chugged through a 412.92 USDT high with 4.9 M USDT changing hands.

Circle's $CRCLB is the quiet one, down 1.17% to 80.21 USDT, sitting between a 79.37 USDT floor and an 82.66 USDT ceiling. It pulled roughly 15.7 M USDT in volume, showing the token keeps moving 24/7.

All three bStocks are ticking along outside regular market hours, no big drama, just the usual crypto-style grind.

$BTC barely budged, up 0.053% to $80,745.34. It hit a high of $81,823 and a low of $80,397.14, with about 11,266 BTC traded.

$ETH slipped 0.397% to $2,342.46. The rally peaked at $2,387.5, then fell to $2,323.2; volume topped 150k ETH.

$BNB dropped 0.274% to $749.28. The range was $762.2-$742, and 114,207 BNB changed hands.

All three sat in tight bands, so watch whether any break of those highs or lows pops up. Looks like a flat-line morning.

$BTC closed at $80,776, up 0.7% after hitting $81,823 and holding above $79,890. $ETH nudged to $2,340, a 0.6% rise, with a high of $2,387.5 and a low near $2,315.77. $BNB led the pack, finishing at $754, up 1.6% after a swing between $740.2 and $762.2. Volume was solid across the board, $BTC around 12.6k, $ETH over 206k, $BNB about 131k. Keep an eye on $BNB's next resistance; the token's fresh momentum could test the $760-$770 zone.

$PEPE is buzzing, it jumped 12.5% and swung about 15.2% of its price in 24 h, nearly double its usual 8.5% daily range.

$SOXL saw a 12.7% gain and moved 15.1% today, a touch wider than its typical 11.6% range, so it's a bit more volatile than usual.

$BNB was almost flat, up 0.8% with a 2.7% swing, just a hair above its normal 2.5% range.

All three moved enough to notice, but only $PEPE really broke out of its regular rhythm.

$BTC is at $80,791, up 1.04% in 24 h. It peaked near $80,836 before slipping back to the low-end of the day around $79,506. Volume hit about 12,951 BTC, pushing quote volume past $1.04 bn.

$ETH sits on $2,346, gaining 1.66%. The rally pushed it to $2,358 before retreating to $2,297. Trading was busy, over 204 k ETH moved, worth roughly $476 mm.

$BNB closed at $748, up 0.88%. High of $754 gave a brief lift, then it settled near the $734 floor. Around 108 k BNB changed hands, totaling about $80.7 mm.

All three nudged higher, but each capped near its recent high and fell back toward the low range. Nothing wild, just a modest bounce across the board.

$BTC's 24-hour swing was about 1.49%, well under its typical 2.47% range, that's roughly a third tighter than usual. It nudged up 0.28% to $80,668.

$ETH moved inside a 2.47% band versus its usual 3.61%, so it's also somewhat tighter. Price rose 0.93% and sits at $2,351.33.

$NEAR's daily range narrowed to 5.78% from an average 8.89%, making its swing about a third tighter too. It jumped 1.81% and is now $4.621.

All three are just a bit more settled than they normally are.

$BTC slipped 0.68% to $79,930, bounced off the day's high of $80,844 before settling near the low of $79,451. Volume held around 14.8 k with $1.18 bn traded.

$ETH dropped 0.83% to $2,317, nudging off its $2,345 peak and hovering just above the $2,296 floor. Activity was brisk, 168.5 k coins changing hands, $390.7 m in quote volume.

$BNB eased 0.41% to $740.5, threading the range between $734 and $747.5. Around 102 k swapped, moving $75.6 m in total.

Watch the $BTC/USDT order flow when it hits the $79,500-$80,000 band tomorrow; any bounce or break could set the tone for the next few sessions.

$BTC held near $79,938, up 0.53% on the day, bounced off a low of $79,368.7 and peaked at $80,844.7. $ETH nudged higher to $2,317.51, +0.82%, with a swing from $2,293.09 up to $2,344.72. $BNB climbed to $740.61, +0.80%, after testing $732.45 and touching $747.47. Volume stayed solid across the board, BTC around 15.2k, ETH over 175k, BNB near 100k.

Watch the $BTC quote volume; it's sitting just over 1.2 billion USDT, a good gauge of where the next short-term push could come from.

$CRCLB slipped to 80.19 USDT, down 5.891% after hitting a high of 85.7 USDT and a low of 79 USDT. Volume's still solid at about 26.2 M USDT, so the tokenized stock kept moving even after US markets closed.

$SNDKB is barely budging, last at 1,262.04 USDT, up just 0.04% from yesterday. It bounced between 1,288.57 USDT and 1,223.46 USDT, with 35.4 M USDT changing hands, proving the Sandisk bStock can stay active around the clock.

Micron's $MUB nudged higher, settling at 906.55 USDT, up 1.549% and touching a high of 916.55 USDT. Trade flow hit roughly 11.96 M USDT, showing the tokenized stock's 24/7 liquidity is still humming.

$BTC slid to $80,406, down 0.48% after flirting with $80,845 and testing $79,369. Volume held around 15k BTC, pushing $1.21 B in quote flow.

$ETH dropped to $2,328, a 1.28% pullback from its $2,359 high, while the low hit $2,293. Heavy hands moved roughly 196k ETH, generating $456 M in quote volume.

$BNB edged up to $745, up 0.35% after peaking at $747.47 and finding support near $732.45. Around 99k BNB changed hands, accounting for $73 M in quote volume.

Watch the $BTC order book depth as the next 1-hour candle forms; any sudden imbalance could spark a quick swing.

$ETH slipped 0.24% against $BTC, now sitting at about 0.0289 BTC. $BTC itself dipped 0.13% in the last 24 h. Meanwhile the 20-coin basket of top alts jumped roughly 2.69%, outpacing Bitcoin nicely. So BTC's under-performing the alt crowd, and ETH is losing a touch of ground to BTC. Nothing wild, just a modest pullback on the big guys and a small rally in the rest.

$BTC slipped to $79,860, down 1.24% after peaking at $81,033. Volume held around 7.26 k BTC, quote flow just under $584 M. $ETH fell 2.04% to $2,314, touched a high of $2,371 before sliding back, with 131.7 k coins changing hands and $308 M in quote volume. $BNB edged lower 0.56% to $739, hovering between $734 and $749; about 82.6 k BNB traded, moving $61.3 M in quotes.

Watch the $BTC intraday range, if it breaks back above $81K the next swing could get interesting.

$BTC barely budged, closing at $80,549 after a high of $81,033.69 and a low of $80,087.70. The 0.014% dip was almost invisible, with 5,771 BTC traded for about $465.3 M.

$ETH nudged up to $2,350.10, up 0.362% on the day. It bounced between $2,318 and $2,371.52, and volume hit 110,426 ETH, pushing quote volume past $259 M.

$BNB led the trio, ending at $742.17, up 1.625% after swinging from $729.82 to $748.65. Roughly 84,243 BNB changed hands, worth $62.5 M.

Watch the $BNB order flow around the $750 mark, any break above could test the next resistance level.

$BTC rode up 1.46% to $80,614.75, hit a high of $81,033.69, then slipped back to the low of $79,220.74. Volume sat around 7 k BTC, pushing quote volume past $562 M.

$ETH jumped 1.90% and closed at $2,339.54, topping out at $2,371.52 before testing $2,285.79. It traded over 142 k ETH, with $332 M in quote volume.

$BNB led the trio, up 2.95% to $741.20, swinging between $718 and $748.65. Roughly 89.9 k BNB changed hands, delivering $66 M in quote volume.

Watch the $BTC 80k-82k band tomorrow, it's the next range where price action could lock in.

$BTC slipped to $80,315, down 0.43% after hitting a high of $81,033 and a low of $79,221. Volume held near 9.7k, so the move felt more like a brief wobble than a panic.

$ETH fell 1.75% to $2,327, touching $2,373 at the top and bottoming out around $2,282. Over 200k coins changed hands, pushing quote volume past $474 M.

$BNB nudged up 0.99% to $739.9, trading between $718 and $748.6. With about 119k units traded, quote volume topped $87.5 M.

All three pairs showed a clear split: BTC and ETH edging lower, BNB managing a modest gain. Nothing wild, just the usual 24-hour shuffle.

$BMT surged 26% to $0.0315, punching through its $0.025 low and flashing a $63.4 M quote volume. $ZEC nudged up 3.2% to $1,217, holding near its $1,225 high on $147 M traded. Meanwhile $ERA slid 19% to $0.0724, barely touching its $0.071 low and dragging $20.7 M in volume. The winners are blasting past yesterday's ranges, the loser is stuck in a steep dip. Nothing wild, just a clear split between the top gainer and the biggest laggard.

$ETH/$BTC slipped to 0.02902, down 1.49% against $BTC. Meanwhile $BTC itself fell 0.94% in USD terms. The 20-coin basket, though, nudged up 1.37% on average, so the alt group outperformed $BTC today. In short: $ETH is losing relative strength to $BTC, but the broader alt slice is holding its own and actually beat $BTC's modest dip. Nothing wild, just a small tilt toward the rest of the market.

$BMT surged 67.5% to $0.039, trading in a tight $0.021-$0.051 range and pulling in over $53.9M in quote volume. $ERA also climbed, up about 20.5% to $0.0876, with a high of $0.1031 and $27.2M flowing through. Meanwhile $WLD slipped 12.6% to $0.4636, barely breaking its $0.457-$0.535 band despite the biggest quote volume at $79.6M. Gains on the upside, losses on the downside, just how the 24-hour story unfolded.

$BTC slid 1.28% to $80,662, touching a high of $82,060 before drifting down to a low of $80,451. Volume held around 11.6 k coins, so the sell pressure was clear.

$ETH dropped 1.23% to $2,371 after peaking at $2,418; the floor sat near $2,352. With 159 k ETH traded, the market showed decent liquidity despite the dip.

$BNB fell 1.89% to $733, hitting $750 at the top and barely slipping under $731 on the downside. About 126 k BNB moved through the books, pushing quote volume past $93 m.

All three pairs nudged lower in the last 24 h, each testing their day's range. No big spikes, just a steady slide across the board.

$PEPE's barely creeping up, +1.34% to $0.00000454, volume over $111 M, while $BNB nudged +0.51% to $739.81 on $106 M traded. On the flip side $WLD slammed –13.88% to $0.4795, volume $67 M, still stuck near its low of $0.4711. One side inching higher, the other diving hard. Looks like the meme-coin rally isn't spilling over to the broader market right now.
